observations.detail: A safe .venv/bin/pip install command was outside the bounded executable grammar.
Ubuntu mirror returned 502 Bad Gateway and explicit apt Connection failed messages.
The model repeated the candidate-2 script because the mirror failure was retained as a hypothesis; v17 correctly terminated the timeout as infrastructure Unknown.

generic_corrections: Accept only project-local .venv/venv bin pip and python executable paths as typed package mutations.
Classify explicit upstream HTTP 500/502/503/504 and apt Connection failed signatures as infrastructure Unknown.
